class.name: OpenXRMeshTracker
class.brief_description: Spatial entity tracker for our spatial entity mesh tracking extension.
class.description: Spatial entity tracker for our OpenXR spatial entity mesh tracking extension. These trackers contain mesh data that provide information about the environment around us.

method.name: clear_mesh_data
method.description: Clears the mesh data for this tracker. You should only call this if you are handling your own discovery logic.

method.name: get_indices
method.description: Gets the index data for the mesh.

method.name: get_mesh
method.description: Gets a mesh created from the mesh data provided by the runtime. This mesh is cached and will return the same resource when called while vertex, normal and index data remains unchanged.

method.name: get_mesh_adjusted_offset
method.description: Returns our mesh offset but with world scale applied.

method.name: get_normals
method.description: Gets the normal data for the mesh.

method.name: get_shape
method.description: Gets a collision shape built from the mesh data.

method.name: get_vertices
method.description: Gets the vertex data for the mesh.

members.member: The bounding size of the mesh. This is a 3D size.
Mesh offset from our tracked pose.

signal.name: mesh_changed
signal.description: Emitted when our mesh data has changed the mesh instance and collision needs to be updated.
